description:
Welcome to Grady Holcomb.
I read what the U.S. government actually publishes about the threats headed your way, and I explain it in plain English.
FEMA planning guides. NOAA hazard outlooks. CDC emergency advisories. DHS bulletins. Documents paid for with your tax dollars that most Americans will never open.
Every video is built from those official sources: 14-day emergency kits, county disaster maps, home defense, water and food storage, and the science of surviving heat, cold, floods, and blackouts. No rumors, no guesswork, just what the record says and what to do about it.
The people tracking disasters for a living already know what's coming. My job is to make sure you know it too.
Subscribe. Read the data. Be ready before you have to be.
